record.field:
Planar Polish
Tool: FT Sponge , Palm sander
Abrasive: Med scotchbrite/ Foamtec
Finish: Random brush
Manual polish of the wet part after the DI Water is required to physically remove any incoming surface deposits before acid bath treatment. Use the maroon (medium) scotch brite scrub as required at the edges of all parts to remove the deposits at the edge ONLY. Use on the flat regions of the part only if presence of thick deposits are observed. The manual polish of the flat regions is done using a two-step method:
800 grit followed by 1350 grit Foamtec Pads.
This two-step process is required to remove any visible color variation or other non-conformities. The incoming dents or scratches during part handling will not be removed by the planar polish step and should be documented before the start of planar polish. During the planar polish process, DI Water should be used frequently to remove the polish debris. Also, the polish pads should be supported by polish sponge on the flat regions, and the polishing done in an orbital pattern.

div.root:

Tool: FT Sponge , Palm sander
Abrasive: Med scotchbrite/ Foamtec
Finish: Random brush
Manual polish of the wet part after the DI Water is required to physically remove any incoming surface deposits before acid bath treatment. Use the maroon (medium) scotch brite scrub as required at the edges of all parts to remove the deposits at the edge ONLY. Use on the flat regions of the part only if presence of thick deposits are observed. The manual polish of the flat regions is done using a two-step method:
800 grit followed by 1350 grit Foamtec Pads.
This two-step process is required to remove any visible color variation or other non-conformities. The incoming dents or scratches during part handling will not be removed by the planar polish step and should be documented before the start of planar polish. During the planar polish process, DI Water should be used frequently to remove the polish debris. Also, the polish pads should be supported by polish sponge on the flat regions, and the polishing done in an orbital pattern.

Package: 4-6 mil poly bag
Environment: Class-100
Vacuum: >5" Hg
Single bag vacuum seal all parts. Place ESCAQA part number / serial sticker on first bag. Double bag vacuum seal first bag and all parts.
